info.title: personalaffe
info.description: The HTTP surface of one personalaffe instance. Every instance is at its own address; every endpoint is under `/api`, and every answer carries the instance's version in `Personalaffe-Version`. Errors are one problem document whose relative `type` ends in the code a client switches on.

get.summary: The version of this instance.
Whether this process is running. It touches nothing else.
Whether the database answers and carries the schema this build knows.
Whether this instance still needs its one-time setup.

post.summary: Claim an instance that has no owner. It works exactly once.
Sign in as the owner. The session comes back as a cookie.

delete.summary: End the session this request came in on.

delete.summary: End every signed-in browser but this one.

get.summary: Who the presented credential admits.
Whether a second factor stands between the password and the workspace.

post.summary: Offer a shared secret for an authenticator. Nothing changes until it is confirmed.
Turn the offered authenticator on, and take the recovery codes that come with it.
Turn the second factor off. The recovery codes go with it, and every other browser is signed out.
A fresh set of recovery codes. The old set stops working.
Change the password. Every other browser is signed out.

get.summary: Find something in the applications this caller can read.
get.description: Every word is matched as a beginning and all of them have to be found, so `arch dec` finds "Architecture decisions". At most 8 words are used and single letters are dropped. At most 100 findings come back, 20 where no limit is asked for.

get.summary: What is useful or pending: the tiles, and what is in the ones being drawn.
get.description: Each drawn tile carries at most 5 rows. A section is absent where its tile is hidden, out of this caller's reach or in a switched-off application; it is an empty list where the tile is drawn and there is nothing in it. The weather tile's content is at GET /api/weather.

get.summary: What it is doing where the owner said.
get.description: The body carries a reading only when there is a place, this instance is asking, and the provider answered. `read_at` is when this instance asked, so a client can say how old the number is. The attribution is what a free provider is paid in: show it beside the number.

put.summary: Say where the weather is for, or clear it. The owner's alone.
put.description: Both coordinates and a name, or all three empty to clear it. The answer carries the weather there, so setting a place and seeing it is one request.

get.summary: The places a geocoder thinks a word names. The owner's alone.
get.description: So that saying where the weather is for is typing a name rather than looking two numbers up elsewhere. Empty where the provider did not answer or this instance is not asking anybody.

get.summary: What this instance is called and what its mark looks like.
get.description: Outside the door, because the sign-in screen and the browser tab are drawn before anybody has signed in. `title` is nothing on an instance nobody has named, which means the product name. It is plain text and is never Markdown or HTML.

put.summary: Name this instance and choose its mark. The owner's alone.
put.description: All three, every time. An empty or whitespace title is stored as none and the instance goes back to the product name. Whoever can reach this instance can read what is set here.
